description: List papers by an author's name from arXiv — equivalent to clicking an author's name on any abstract page (arXiv has no author profile pages; author links are author searches). Accepts a natural name ('Yann LeCun' or comma form 'LeCun, Yann') and converts it to an arXiv au: query on the family name. Note: arXiv does not disambiguate authors, so results may include namesakes — use --category to narrow down. Returns paper cards (arXiv ID, title, authors, categories, date, abstract, abs/PDF links), newest first. A single API request fills the requested limit (max 200); partial=true when arXiv has fewer matches than requested. No authentication required.

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Author name in natural form, e.g. "Yann LeCun", "LeCun", or comma form "LeCun, Yann". Converted internally to an arXiv au: query on the family name (the last token; the formal "Last, F" abbreviation is NOT used because it fails on the Atom API). arXiv does not disambiguate authors — same-name collisions are inherent, so results may include namesakes; combine with --category for precision. (作者姓名自然写法，如 "Yann LeCun" / "LeCun"，也兼容 "LeCun, Yann" 逗号式；内部取姓氏末词转为 au: 查询。arXiv 无同名消歧，同名干扰固有存在，建议配合 --category 收窄。)

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Restrict to one arXiv category (e.g. "cs.CV") to reduce namesake noise. Case-sensitive: the subcategory suffix is uppercase (cs.AI, not cs.ai). Run arxiv/list-categories to enumerate all ~176 values. (限定分类以减少同名干扰。大小写敏感：子类后缀大写；全部取值可用 arxiv/list-categories 枚举。)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of papers to return (1-200, default 50). A single API request returns up to this many; partial=true when arXiv has fewer matches than requested. (返回条数上限，默认 50；单请求即拿满，不足请求数时 partial=true。)
